text:
jordan_accts: Heads-up — Greenfield Biotech signed the SOW for a 2-week Private deployment POC. Their netsec team is strict: inline TLS inspection, corporate proxy w/ SNI rewriting, and strict egress allowlists. We need a short runbook for them to validate connectivity and note any limitations (streaming, websockets, chunked responses). Test window next Tue.

lee_neteng: Congrats. TL;DR: PrivateLink preferred because it avoids changing route tables and keeps traffic off the public internet. But if their proxy intercepts TLS and re-terminates, streaming may break. Need to know whether they can do TCP passthrough to the VPCE ENI.

jordan_accts: They said they can modify the proxy for selected FQDNs. They asked if we can use a customer-provided cert on our endpoint, or if SNI must match api.redwood.internal.

tara_se: We do not accept customer certs on the interface endpoint; the endpoint service presents our cert. However, if they preserve SNI (api.redwood-inference.internal) across TLS inspection rules, everything works. If they terminate TLS and reissue certs, chunked transfer-encoding and streaming may be rebuffered by the proxy — causing latency and sometimes timeouts.

lee_neteng: For the POC we can provide a short list of NAT egress IPs in the region. Important firewall rules: allow outbound TCP 443 from their endpoint subnets to the VPCE ENI IPs and allow inbound ICMP/ephemeral only from our test runner IP for connectivity tests. Example SG entries in their account: 

```
# Customer security group example (in their VPC)
Outbound: TCP 443 to vpce-<redwood-svc-id> (vpce ENI IPs)
Inbound (test): TCP 22 from jump-box-ip/32, ICMP from 3.101.45.12/32 (our test runner)
```

lee_neteng: Also: if they use proxy that does SNI rewriting, require them to add a bypass rule for api.redwood-inference.internal to be passed through unchanged.

jordan_accts: They want a concrete curl command and tcpdump guidance to prove the path end-to-end.

tara_se: Send them this minimal verification snippet. It checks SNI and TLS chain and verifies chunked responses are preserved.

```bash
# replace <vpce-eni-ip> and <test-token>
curl -v --resolve api.redwood-inference.internal:443:<vpce-eni-ip> \
  https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/healthz \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" --http1.1

# capture first 30s of traffic from test host to ENI
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <vpce-eni-ip> and port 443 -w pcap-vpce.pcap -c 1000
```

jordan_accts: Nice. Also procurement asked: will the POC incur extra fees because of PrivateLink usage?

lee_neteng: PrivateLink itself is billed by AWS (interface endpoint hours + data processing), and our hosted control plane usage applies. For the short POC we don't change product pricing, but if they require dedicated reserved capacity (static IPs, SLA), that's a separate contract. We'll surface expected AWS endpoint costs in the handoff.

tara_se: Security FAQ snippet for their questionnaire: 

"Redwood supports PrivateLink (recommended) and VPC peering for Private deployments. For customers performing TLS interception, we require SNI preservation for api.redwood-inference.internal or TCP passthrough to the PrivateLink ENI to maintain streaming semantics. We provide region-specific egress IP ranges for POC testing; production Dedicated deployments can have stable IP ranges and an SLA. Full architecture diagrams, IP lists, and test commands will be supplied during engineering handoff."

lee_neteng: Operational note: if the proxy does TLS interception and cannot be adjusted, we can run an alternative test using a small jump host in their VPC to perform an unproxied TCP test to the ENI. That helps us differentiate proxy vs network issues. Request they provide a traceroute (mtr) from the jump host and the tcpdump pcap.

jordan_accts: I'll consolidate and send to their network lead. Can we also provide a short CloudFormation example to create the interface endpoint in permitted subnets?

lee_neteng: Yes, I'll DM a minimal CFN snippet and the temporary EIP ranges.

ops-bot: [keygen] Issued temporary POC credentials: greenfield-poc-token (expires in 48h).

jordan_accts: Action items:
- lee_neteng: post CFN sample and POC IP ranges (ETA today EOD)
- tara_se: finalize the questionnaire snippet and the curl/tcpdump commands into one paste (ETA today)
- greenfield: IT to run the curl and tcpdump tests during Tues window and share pcap/traceroute if issues

lee_neteng: on it. I'll include a note about MTU/path-MTU issues too — some interception appliances lower MTU and can break TLS records.

jordan_accts: Thanks team — I'll send this as a single email to the Greenfield network team now.
